audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill on rows 0,1,3,4,6 while the content layer read Akshan, Akshan, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia. Five rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: The content chart matches the data (52.55% to Cassiopeia over 666 games) and matches the kit: Avengerang matches your 850 range on a 9s cooldown and Dirty Fighting shields every third hit, so he owns levels 1-2; from 4 onward Twin Fang's 0.75s cycle and its heal off poisoned targets out-sustain a 70-mana Heroic Swing.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content verdicts on all five rows, each with a rewritten why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' Heroic Swing window.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5s, Comeuppance 100/85/70s. Fifteen seconds is the rank-3 number, not the lane number.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] called Comeuppance an execute you dodge as a skillshot. It is neither: it locks on, scales with missing health, and stops on the first thing it hits. That body-block is the decisive interaction and it was never stated. Also unstated: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit, so your burst window is smaller than it looks.
audit.why: Riot text: 'locks onto an enemy champion and starts storing bullets... dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.' Passive text: 'Every three hits... grants him a Shield if the target was a champion.' Both flagged in _missing for this pair.
audit.corrected: Comeuppance rewritten around the minion body-block and missing-health scaling; the shield folded into phases[1].why, report[8] and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim), one cooldowns field with no digit, and report[8] telling you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' when Akshan has a shield and no heal.
audit.why: Dirty Fighting grants a shield, not healing, so Grievous Wounds is the wrong first response.
